assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One isolated production sprite for a compact top-down pixel roguelike, slight front/top view, true transparent background. Image 1 is approved STYLE reference only: very chunky hard square pixels, broad silhouette, 12-14 flat colors, 2 shades per material, dark outline. No gradient, glow, antialiasing, noisy texture, tiny machinery details, text, people or scene. Make it readable at a very coarse logical pixel grid. A squat wide open garage portal, dark teal steel lintel with dull brass edge bands and two chunky steel posts. Small simple crossed wrench-and-hammer badge centered on lintel, no lettering. This is a garage service gate, not a castle arch or decorative shop awning. Completely transparent central opening extending down to bottom, no door leaves, no shutter, no floor, no lower threshold. Design 64x32 logical pixels, uprights about 6 pixels wide each and opening about 48 pixels wide. Keep the silhouette low and rectangular, compatible with roguelike stone walls.
